topics.title: My Favourite Hobby
topics.prompt: What is your favourite hobby? When did you start it? Who do you do it with? Why do you enjoy it?
topics.sample_answer: My favourite hobby is collecting stamps. I started this hobby two years ago. I usually collect stamps with my brother. I enjoy it because I can learn about different countries and cultures. I often spend my free time looking for new stamps.

topics.title: Benefits of Hobbies
topics.description: Talk about the benefits of having a hobby.
topics.prompt: Why should people have hobbies? What can they learn from their hobbies? How can hobbies help them in daily life?
topics.sample_answer: I think everyone should have a hobby. Hobbies help us relax after studying or working. They can also help us become more creative and learn new skills. For example, playing sports makes us healthier. Hobbies are a good way to spend our free time.

topics.title: A Hobby I Want to Try
topics.description: Talk about a hobby you would like to try in the future.
topics.prompt: What hobby would you like to try? Why do you want to try it? What do you need to start this hobby?
topics.sample_answer: In the future, I would like to learn how to play the guitar. I think it is an exciting hobby. I want to play my favourite songs and share music with my friends. I need a guitar and some time to practise every day.
